scenes.title: A swimmer's start
scenes.caption: Joseph Schooling is born on 16 June 1995 in Singapore and grows up in the pool.
scenes.visual: A neighbourhood public swimming pool on a sunny morning, public-housing blocks and palms behind. A small boy in goggles, seen from behind, sits on the pool edge holding a kickboard.

scenes.title: Meeting his idol
scenes.caption: At 13, he meets Michael Phelps on a visit to Singapore before the Beijing Olympics. It pushes him to train in the US.
scenes.visual: Poolside at a training session: a tall swimmer in a parka and a 13-year-old boy, both seen from behind, stand side by side looking at the pool. Photographers' flashes pop at the side.

scenes.title: Off to Bolles
scenes.caption: In 2009 he enrols at the Bolles School in Jacksonville, Florida, a year after meeting Phelps.
scenes.visual: A teenager seen from behind stands with a large suitcase at an airport window at sunrise, a jet on the tarmac outside and palm trees reflected in the glass.

scenes.title: A Longhorn in Texas
scenes.caption: He enrols at the University of Texas at Austin in 2014, training and racing for the Longhorns.
scenes.visual: A college indoor natatorium: a deep blue competition pool, a swimmer mid-butterfly stroke as a dark silhouette, timing boards on the wall, a crowd in orange in the bleachers.

scenes.title: Gold in Rio
scenes.caption: On 12 August 2016 he wins the 100 m butterfly in 50.39 seconds, an Olympic record, ahead of Phelps. It is Singapore's first Olympic gold.
scenes.visual: An Olympic final: a swimmer surging through the water in a butterfly stroke, arms raised, splashes frozen in mid-air, lane ropes and stadium lights. A large blank dark scoreboard hangs above the pool.

scenes.title: A hero's return
scenes.caption: Singapore erupts in celebration. He receives S$1 million under the national reward scheme, and his National Service is deferred until after Tokyo 2020.
scenes.visual: An open-top double-decker bus on a sunny city street lined with shophouses, paper streamers and confetti drifting in the air. On the top deck a lone swimmer in a red team jacket, seen from behind, holds up a gold medal.

scenes.title: The final lap
scenes.caption: After a 2017 world bronze, an early exit at Tokyo 2020 and a 2022 admission of cannabis use abroad, he retires from competitive swimming on 2 April 2024.
scenes.visual: Dusk at an empty Olympic pool, still water reflecting the lights. Goggles and a swim cap rest on a starting block, with a gold medal hanging from it.
